headline: WICHEEDA HITS 6.15% RARE EARTH GRADES OVER 20m — BC Resource Upgrade Drilling Returns Program Best In 65m At 2.86% TREO
snippet: Defense Metals Corp. (TSXV: DEFN) announced August 31 assay results from 11 resource-upgrade drill holes at its Wicheeda Rare Earth Project near Prince George, BC: the program best is hole WI26-96, returning 2.86% TREO over 65 metres with a higher-grade core of 6.15% TREO over 20.3 metres — the highest concentration drilled at Wicheeda to date. Hole WI26-93 cut the southern deposit margin and returned 1.7% TREO over 184 metres from 91.6m depth. With China's January 2026 strategic reclassification of rare earths and tightening export licensing, a Western-jurisdiction heavy-REE resource delivering grades at this level is exactly what the supply chain rebuild needs.

headline: CATE-8 SILVER ZONE GROWS 55%: INDIVIDUAL SAMPLES TO 16.3 OZ/TON AG — Idaho's Bunker Hill Eyes 2.79M-Oz AgEq Resource Estimate By Year-End
snippet: Bunker Hill Mining Corp. (TSX: BNKR) announced August 31 additional results from the Cate-8 vein in the historic Coeur d'Alene district, Idaho: individual drill samples hit 16.3 oz/ton silver with 41.1% lead and 7.41% zinc, while the combined interval reached 14.03 metres at 166 g/t AgEq. Channel sampling across a newly completed underground drift cut 46 feet of 8.19% lead and 2.49 oz/ton silver. The Cate-8 exploration target now stands at 522,000 tons at 5.34 oz/ton AgEq for 2.79 million ounces of silver equivalent — 55% more tonnage than the prior calculation — with an initial NI 43-101 resource estimate targeted by year-end. With silver at $66+, this is the kind of high-grade near-mine system that gets re-rated fast.

headline: VIOR GOLD HITS DEEPEST LIGNERIS INTERCEPT YET: 6.43 g/t Au AT 845m — Abitibi System Extends As 2,600 Assays Queue At Lab
snippet: Vior Gold Corporation (TSXV: VIO) released September 1 results from its 30,000m Ligneris program in the Abitibi region of Quebec: hole LI-26-038 returned 6.43 g/t Au over 4.9 metres including 8.55 g/t Au over 3.0 metres from 845 metres depth — the deepest high-grade result to date, drilled 150 metres south of the prior best hole LI-26-012. Two rigs are also active on the adjacent Kinebik target with 6,500 metres drilled since July 16. The program has completed 25,500 metres with 2,600 assays pending at the laboratory, setting up a sustained newsflow window through Q3 in one of the Abitibi's most active high-grade gold corridors.

headline: INDEPENDENCE GOLD CONFIRMS GOOFY VEIN AT DEPTH: 5.12 g/t Au, 33.04 g/t Ag Over 9.23m — 30m Below Original 14.70 g/t Discovery Hole
snippet: Independence Gold Corp. (TSXV: IGO) announced August 31 drill results from the Goofy Vein at its 100%-owned 3Ts Gold Project, 185 km southwest of Prince George, BC: hole 3TS-26-48 returned 9.23 metres at 5.12 g/t gold and 33.04 g/t silver, intersected approximately 30 metres below the original discovery hole 3TS-26-39, which returned 14.70 g/t gold over 9.10 metres. The vertical confirmation of high-grade values establishes the Goofy Vein as a structurally persistent target rather than a shallow oxidized surface anomaly. Located 250 metres west of the Ted-Mint Vein System, this is a second distinct discovery zone at 3Ts with room to grow in multiple directions.

headline: BENZ MINING BANKS A$150M AT ZERO DISCOUNT — 14 Rigs, 450,000m Glenburgh Campaign Targets One Of World's Largest Gold Drill Programs
snippet: Benz Mining Corp. (TSXV: BZ / ASX: BNZ) closed a A$150,000,000 private placement on August 30 at A$3.71 per share — zero discount to the last close — to fund an accelerated 450,000m drill campaign at its Glenburgh and Mt Egerton gold projects in Western Australia. Proceeds add six rigs to the on-site fleet, scaling up to 14 rigs across 20 shifts and targeting a maiden Mineral Resource Estimate for Glenburgh by H1 2027. At 450,000m, this is expected to rank among the largest active gold exploration drill campaigns globally. Institutional willingness to fund at market price, at this scale, signals conviction in the Glenburgh gold system that the junior market has rarely seen.

headline: LAHONTAN COMPLETES SANTA FE STOCKPILE DRILL PROGRAM — Nine Holes Average 1.96 g/t AuEq, Best 10.7m At 1.81 g/t Au, 64.8 g/t Ag
snippet: Lahontan Gold Corp. (TSXV: LG) released September 1 final results from its Santa Fe Mine stockpile drill program in Nevada: nine Sonic core holes averaged 1.96 g/t AuEq (1.64 g/t Au, 36.2 g/t Ag) with the best interval returning 10.7 metres at 1.81 g/t gold and 64.8 g/t silver. For a heap-leach development project, a confirmed-grade existing stockpile shortens the path from first production to cashflow — it removes the operational ramp-up risk that often kills economics in early-stage heap-leach operations, and provides built-in flexibility from commissioning day one.

headline: SONORO GOLD'S 50,000m CERRO CALICHE CAMPAIGN — Initial 10,000m Results Released As 46-Hole Phase I Defines Mexico Heap-Leach Site
snippet: Sonoro Gold Corp. (TSXV: SGO) released September 1 assay results from the initial 10,000 metres of an ongoing 50,000m reverse circulation campaign at its Cerro Caliche gold project in Sonora, Mexico. Forty-six RC holes targeted the central-western region — the proposed open-pit heap-leach mining area. Phase I (25,000m, ~207 holes) is expected to complete by autumn 2026, with Phase II continuing through Spring 2027. Cerro Caliche is structured as a low-capex, high-altitude oxide gold development, and the 50,000m program is aimed at defining a significantly larger resource base to anchor project economics ahead of a feasibility study.

headline: AI DATA CENTRES BECOME COPPER'S NEW DEMAND FLOOR — Power Grid And Nuclear Buildout Underpins $6.70/Lb Despite Rate Hike Headwinds
snippet: FXEmpire's critical metals analysis argues that artificial intelligence infrastructure — specifically the copper wiring in data centres, EV charging networks, and nuclear power build-outs required to power them — is acting as a structural demand floor beneath copper near $6.70/lb, insulating it from the rate-hike headwinds that have pressured gold and speculative assets since Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks. While lithium and uranium face mixed near-term pressure, copper's structural supply deficit (Grasberg and Kamoa-Kakula supply holes still open through year-end) and AI electricity-demand thematic keep it as the preferred critical metals play for investors who want commodity exposure with a clear and measurable demand narrative.

headline: GOLD, SILVER, PGMS SLIDE AS MARKETS BRACE FOR SEPTEMBER FOMC — Rate Hike Odds Above 60% As Precious Metals Test Central Bank Support
snippet: Precious metals across the complex opened September 1 under pressure — gold at $4,456/oz, silver at $66.61/oz — as markets hold September FOMC rate hike odds above 60% following Chair Warsh's August 31 Jackson Hole hawkishness. Gold is now 21% below its January $5,600 record high and silver remains well off its $121.67 peak, but both metals are holding far above pre-2026 levels. Key risk is a September FOMC hike delivering a confidence shock to precious metals momentum; key support is the central bank buying floor that has historically absorbed speculative liquidation at sub-$4,300 gold — a pattern visible in August's price action.

headline: AGNICO AND ANGLOGOLD DOWN 40% FROM 2026 HIGHS — September Screen Finds Gold Equities Not Pricing In $4,500 Gold
snippet: Canadian Mining Report's September 2026 gold equity fundamentals screen finds both Agnico Eagle Mines (TSX: AEM) and AngloGold Ashanti (NYSE: AGA) down nearly 40% from their 2026 highs despite gold still trading above $4,450 — a gap the analysis attributes to broader equity market risk-off selling and the market's failure to re-price operating leverage to current gold. At today's share prices, major gold producers are effectively being valued as if gold will revert toward $3,000, not hold at $4,500. The analysis argues the risk-to-reward ratio for mid-tier producers with clean balance sheets and existing production profiles is among the best seen in the current bull market.
